content.heading: Practice at 60 BPM (Largo / Adagio)
bodyParagraphs: 60 BPM (Beats Per Minute) represents exactly one beat per second. It is a slow, steady tempo ideal for practicing precision, mastering basic rhythms, and practicing instrument scales.
Use this preset metronome tool to build muscle memory and practice timing at a slow tempo.

title: 5/4 Time Signature Metronome – Odd Meter Practice Click
description: Free online metronome configured for 5/4 odd time signature. Practice quintuple meter music easily in your browser.

content.heading: Practice in 5/4 Odd Time Signature
bodyParagraphs: 5/4 time signature (quintuple meter) consists of five quarter-note beats per measure, famously heard in jazz classics like 'Take Five' and progressive rock/soundtracks.
Our metronome clicks on the downbeat of each measure, helping you stay oriented through irregular rhythmic groupings like 3+2 or 2+3.

content.heading: Practice in 7/8 Complex Time Signature
bodyParagraphs: 7/8 time signature contains seven eighth-notes per measure, creating an asymmetrical rhythmic pulse. It is frequently grouped as 2+2+3 or 3+2+2.
Use this odd meter metronome to build confidence playing complex progressive riffs, classical pieces, or folk rhythms.
